title: Rational and common-stage signed tensor symmetries
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the rational constructible category $D^b_c(W,E)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], the common-finite-stage category $D^b_c(W,\Omega)$ of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], and their derived tensor functors and specified scalar-extension/tensor comparisons of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Write $\sigma^{\mathcal O_E}_{M,N}$ for the coherent-reduction-normalized integral Koszul symmetry of [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints], whose underlying cochain exchange in degrees $(i,j)$ is $x\otimes y\mapsto(-1)^{ij}y\otimes x$.

For $M,N\in D^b_c(W,E)$, define $\sigma^E_{M,N}:M\otimes_E^L N\xrightarrow{\sim}N\otimes_E^L M$ as the unique isomorphism whose hom is the image of $\sigma^{\mathcal O_E}_{M,N}$ under the integral-to-rational localization functor, using the specified tensor-object identifications. Here the integral representatives are the unchanged objects of the rational category.

For $M,N\in D^b_c(W,\Omega)$, define $\sigma^\Omega_{M,N}:M\otimes_\Omega^L N\xrightarrow{\sim}N\otimes_\Omega^L M$ as the unique isomorphism with the following pinning at every finite coefficient field $L\subset\Omega$ containing the stages of both common-stage tensor objects: its hom is the class over $L$ of the rational symmetry $\sigma^L_{M_L,N_L}$ conjugated by the specified source and target scalar-extension/tensor comparisons. Thus its representative is $c_{M,N,L}$ followed by $\sigma^L_{M_L,N_L}$ followed by $c_{N,M,L}^{-1}$. Include the uniqueness statements for these two prescribed isomorphisms; no arbitrary tensor symmetry or choice of a single coefficient stage is introduced.
